//: Pyright config for the Django shell. Suppresses cross-stack noise
that surfaced five sessions in a row (SESSION 107-110) without ever
indicating a real defect. Runtime (`python manage.py check`) is the
authoritative correctness gate; pyright is advisory.
Three classes of noise this config addresses:
1. `apps.* could not be resolved` — cross-app imports work at
runtime because Django adds the project root to sys.path on
boot, but pyright analyses files in isolation.
2. `Method get_queryset overrides ... in an incompatible manner
... base method returns type Never` — drift in DRF's type
3. `Type analysis indicates code is unreachable` — fires after
